list_hooks_configured: list all configured shell hooks with their event, command, timeout, and allowlist status
test_hook_event: test a shell hook for a specific event with optional tool filter and custom payload file
revoke_hook_entry: revoke an allowlisted shell hook entry by command path
doctor_check_hooks: run a health check on all configured shell hooks for script existence, allowlist, and JSON output
summarize_hooks_command: summarize the hermes hooks CLI entry point that dispatches list, test, revoke, and doctor subcommands
